description:
Bayview Diwali just got brighter, bigger and so much more special after last evening’s celebration! ✨🪔
A heartfelt thank you to all our members and spouses who joined us and filled the evening with so much love, warmth and enthusiasm. ❤️

A few special mentions & heartfelt thanks to the people who made the evening even more special! ❤️
✨ Alpana shah for the beautiful décor .
🎁Mr T. C. Guruprasad & EbixCash for generously sponsoring the premium gifts.
🌸 Our 2 anonymous members for sponsoring the mehndi experience.

And last but certainly not the least, our Qawwali backbone team – Meghna Sanghvi, Nikeeta Mehta, Kanan Mehta, Jitin Sanghvi , ruchita mehta & Prakruti vardhan ... for all the hard work, planning and behind-the-scenes efforts that brought the evening alive!🙏🔥
